::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Yelahanka) startup developing 5G and LTE-Advanced chipsets and RF transceivers for broadband and IoT, with designs it says are compatible with Tata Electronics' planned 28/22nm process. No tape-out publicly reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

5G/LTE-Advanced baseband chipsets and RF transceivers with a full software stack.
